title: fix: refuse image sizes under 16 px instead of passing them on
author: NamanSoni78

gist.summary: Image requests now reject zero or negative GET width/height and POST size dimensions. Image dimensions under 16 px per side return a field-specific 400 before reaching a provider, rather than being silently resized or returning a provider error. Video models still accept small positive dimensions as aspect ratios, including 16×9; community video endpoints discard width and height before image-parameter validation. Model-specific image minimums above 16 px still apply.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel-art garden shed, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and checks a 16-pixel ruler beside a framed image, while a separate video screen shows a 16×9 aspect ratio; code-plants grow around a lime green (#ecf874) terminal. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She should be small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements — never oversized or dominating the image. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with warm cream surroundings and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
